application: Source-run Electron with production UI, isolated profile and disposable loopback HTTP server on Xvfb

checks.name: Queued chat has a truthful native status and remains cancellable
checks.observed: Selected the waiting chat through search. The sidebar displayed Waiting for local model and exposed Stop. Clicking Stop completed that chat with ok=false. The fixture still reported received=1 and pending=1, proving the cancelled second chat sent no generation POST.

checks.name: Generation slots transfer between native chats and clear their phase
checks.observed: A fresh pair of chats reported generating and waiting-model respectively. Releasing the first fixture response completed its chat with ok=true and admitted the second. Releasing the second completed it with ok=true. Both replies matched the fixture response and both modelPhase fields were absent afterward. An earlier intentionally held request reached its request timeout during UI navigation; this fresh pair was used for completion verification.

checks.name: Concurrency preference is editable and persisted through the desktop host
checks.observed: Settings > Connections > Edit showed Parallel local requests with 1, 2 and 4 choices. Selected 2 and saved. The native state RPC reported localConcurrency=2 and reopening the editor selected 2. Changed back to 1 through the same UI before the fresh ordered-completion check.

limits: All generation checks used a disposable server, not a real inference runtime. No model weights, KV cache, VRAM, packaged builds or cross-platform memory were measured. Admission is per local service and app process, and only configured local direct/built-in-agent requests pass through it. Other clients, native CLI agents and runtime preallocation remain outside the limiter. Test app and fixture server were stopped afterward.
